Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
CONTROLS (observed): WASD moves; arrow keys fire/set facing; a key+arrow combo moves and fires simultaneously in independent directions (strafe-fire confirmed repeatedly). E places bombs (left-click does not). Space uses active item (no visible effect with Match Stick or Tech X). Q uses/drops card (no confirmed effect). Fine movement: 0.1s≈40px, 0.2s≈80px, 0.3s≈120px, 0.5s≈200px. Inputs occasionally drop: if a direction stalls, retry or test single axes rather than assuming a wall. Door/hatch/trapdoor/alcove transitions need centered overlap PLUS 2–3 repeated presses; a single press almost never works. If presses fail, step out and re-enter or nudge 0.1s. Player sprite renders inconsistently (white/pink blob, TV-head, skull, pale damage-blink, gray-faced) and can resemble enemies—confirm identity by moving and watching which sprite responds. Tech X rings sometimes auto-burst with no obvious input (seen in dark stone room and rock room).

HUD/PICKUPS (observed): hearts hollow after damage; blue/soul hearts from blue pill; counters for coins, keys, bombs; two item/card slots; top-right icon stack. All-hollow hearts observed repeatedly: once preceded run end, but several times the room stayed interactive and controllable—treat as critical/ambiguous, keep playing until a result screen. Pickups on touch but coins/small items need exact overlap and may register a step late (Match Stick banner delayed). Silent inert floor objects exist (cup beside rocky cluster, floor matchstick, gray outlined tile) — scenery, not pickups. Poop sometimes hides items; many inert. Crates may damage on contact; some vanish or act mimic-like. A pickup pedestal can re-grant TECH X (seen in two-poop chamber). A heart pickup dropped at range after an enemy died (seen in rock room). Keyhole doors: the gold-framed left door in the rock room, opened/walked through with 1 key held, did NOT consume the key (counter stayed 1). A keyed side-door may not be openable by standing/pressing—more testing needed.

TECH X (observed): radial ring tear with red X impact, radius ~140–150px; blocks own line of fire; point-blank unsafe. Damages fats, gray faces, shelled enemies, flies, clustered spiders. Does NOT crack rock rings, TNT barrels, gray crates, or rock clusters; embedded eye-faces survive (likely invulnerable). y-offset >~70px misses. Item banners (TECH X; MATCH STICK 'Tastes like burning'; 2 OF SPADES 'Item multiplier') can replace active item; after Match Stick, ring bursts stopped visibly firing (unconfirmed). Space with Match Stick produced no effect in two rooms.

ENEMIES: winged flies tanky, chase/fire tears downward, guard hatches. Fat pink/white/gray-faced enemies very tanky, enrage with red aura/red cheeks, chase relentlessly, contact drains hearts fast; die in red splatter. Shelled white-faced enemies emerge from spiky rock piles, fire blue/green orbs, retreat into rock form (immune while shelled), leave persistent damaging green spiky clouds that can kill a low-HP player—never linger near them; a flattened/white-topped spiky form means alive/re-submerging, red splatter confirms death. Shelled enemies can appear in multiple rooms and re-emerge after apparent death. Bomb-bugs burst-immune, idle until approached, can chain-detonate TNT with delayed secondary blasts (a chain fired seconds later, cost a heart). Black spiders cluster, deadly at close range. Green spiky clouds, poison puddles, brazier flames, orbs, teardrops, falling sack tears damage. Gilded sack with fly fires teardrops. A floating skull/bug creature seen in TNT room.

NAVIGATION (observed/revised): Tutorial room ('BASEMENT I', MOVE/ATTACK/BOMB/ITEM paintings): top hatch ↔ brown rock room; bottom trapdoor ↔ brazier room; right dark riveted door ↔ dark stone room. Brown/rock room (brown, rock-strewn, hub): top hatch ↔ TNT room; bottom trapdoor ↔ tutorial; left gold-framed keyhole door ↔ SHOP room (walked through with a key, key not consumed; earlier with 0 keys it never opened). Shop room: keeper at top-center with a gray pot beside it (possibly breakable — shooting near keeper made it display '!' anger marker; stop firing, leave), items for sale: bomb 5¢ and 2 OF SPADES card 15¢; right-wall gold-handled door ↔ brown rock room. TNT room: two isolated TNT barrels mid-room flank a safe central gap; left wall TNT cluster, gray crates (inert to bombs/tears), reddish barrel; bomb-bug idles left; top hatch ↔ boss room; bottom trapdoor ↔ brown rock room. Boss room: central rock pile blocks fire lanes; dark left-wall statue with red glow/eyes (undamaged by attacks); embedded eye-faces in right rock wall (invulnerable); gilded sack with fly at right firing teardrops; card on floor; two fat enemies roam; bottom trapdoor ↔ TNT room; no other exit. Brazier room: four damaging corner braziers; central chest inside solid rock ring—bombs/Tech X failed, chest inert even when reached; enter ring via left-lower diagonal gap near x≈550,y≈365 with small diagonal w/a steps; poop left of ring inert; bottom-center golden gate ↔ two-poop chamber; top-center alcove ↔ tutorial; left corridor bypasses ring. Two-poop chamber: two poops flank central rock; recurring faint gray outlined floor tile never opens (maybe shadow marker needing bomb—untested); yellow key-like sliver appeared and vanished without raising key counter; TECH X pedestal here; top golden gate ↔ brazier room; dead end otherwise. Dark stone room: left exit ↔ tutorial; two red-barred chests top wall (open/close unclear); central red spiked chest inside a damaging white spike cross; two floor holes (probably pits); black spiders spawn inside. Extremely punishing—retreat at low HP.

FAILED/CAUTION: attacking boss-room statue; attacking embedded eye-faces; shooting bomb-bugs; shooting/bombing crates, rock rings, TNT barrels, rock clusters; approaching the brazier ring chest expecting loot; assuming chests won't hurt; lingering in green/poison clouds, bomb-chain smoke, or brazier fire; shooting into adjacent walls; assuming one press opens hatches; standing adjacent to shelled enemies or fats; kiting with no plan at 1 HP (fats and sack tears closed in and drain
